test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for multiple items
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several catalog items, providing detailed context and explanations. The initial email establishes the quote request context, listing specific items and quantities, and includes extra information about the intended use and preferences. No approval or order confirmation is included in this initial turn.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Household and Toy Items
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out to request a detailed quote for a selection of items that I am considering for both home use and gifts for family members. I would appreciate it if you could provide pricing, availability, and any relevant details for the following products:

- 2 units of WonderWash Washing Machine (Item No: AITEM-0100). These are intended for two separate households, so if there are any bundle offers or delivery options, please let me know.
- 1 SmartToys Fast Car Set (Item No: AITEM-0017). This is for a birthday gift, so information about packaging or gift options would be helpful.
- 3 T-Shirts (Item No: AITEM-0022). I am interested in different sizes, but I am not sure which sizes are available. Please include size options in your quote.
- 1 Rug (Item No: AITEM-0031). This will be used in a living room, so if there are color or size variants, kindly specify them.

If you require any additional information from my side to prepare the quote, please let me know. I am looking forward to your response with the requested details.

Best regards,
Tom Martinez (Home)

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for multiple catalog items
test_cases.description: A recognized customer sends a detailed and polite email requesting a quote for several catalog items, providing extra context and explanations. The initial turn establishes the business context and requested items, setting up for a later quote review and order confirmation.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote – Multiple Items for Upcoming Event
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Danish Pastry, and I am reaching out from our office in Copenhagen as we are preparing for an upcoming community event. We are looking to source a variety of products and would appreciate your assistance in providing a detailed quote so we can plan our budget accordingly.

Specifically, we are interested in the following items:

- 10 units of AdventureCraft Building Blocks, as these are popular with children and will be used in our activity stations.
- 5 T-Shirts (we noticed several variants in your catalog, such as AITEM-0022, AITEM-0023, AITEM-0024, AITEM-0025; could you please clarify the differences or recommend the best option for a general giveaway?)
- 3 WonderWagon Pull-Along Train sets, which we believe will be a great addition to our play area.
- 2 Rasta Coffee Grinders for our refreshment booth.

If you require any further information regarding our intended use or quantities, please let me know. We would appreciate a comprehensive quote including any applicable discounts for bulk purchases, estimated delivery timelines, and payment terms.

Best regards,
Danish Pastry

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Bakery Supplies
initial_turn.body:
Hi there,

We're gearing up for a busy season at French Bakery and need to replenish some supplies. Could you please send us a quote for the following items? We're looking to compare options before placing an order, so any details you can provide (like lead times or bulk pricing) would be super helpful.

Here's what we're after:
- Pizza (we noticed you have a few variants, so please include all available types in the quote)
- Soda - Medium (we'd like to know if there are any discounts for larger quantities)
- Apples (these are for our fruit tarts, so freshness is key)
- WonderWash Washing Machine (we're considering this for our kitchen linens, so if you have any info on installation or maintenance, let us know)

If you need any more info from our side, just ask! Looking forward to your reply.

Best,
French Bakery

Best regards,
French Bakery
